## Level-Up Flow

**When offered:** XP thresholds (`XP_THRESHOLDS`, `worker/src/types/index.ts:175`): 0, 300, 900, 2700, 6500, 14000, 23000, 34000, 48000, 64000 (max level 10). Worker's `shouldLevelUp(character)` (`services/character.ts:159`) checks `xp >= XP_THRESHOLDS[level] && level < 10`, returned as `canLevelUp` from `POST /api/action` and `POST /api/combat/resolve`. Frontend also pre-computes it (`character-state.service.ts:52,76` `checkLevelUp`) but the server value wins (`game-console.component.ts:128,155`). UI surfaces: a banner on the character sheet (`character-sheet.component.html:66`) and an ability-picker in the console sidebar (`game-console.component.html:19-28`), prompted after combat via a system message.

**Endpoint call:** Picking an ability in `game-console.component.ts:183` `levelUp(key)` calls `GameApiService.levelUp(sessionId, characterId, abilityChoice)` (`game-api.service.ts:74`), which hits **`POST /api/levelup`** (`worker/src/routes/levelup.ts:10`). `abilityChoice` must be one of str/dex/con/int/wis/cha (`:23-25`); returns 400 if `!shouldLevelUp`.

**Character changes** (`services/character.ts:133` `levelUp`):
- `level` +1
- HP: `roll(class hit die) + CON mod` added to both `max_hp` and current HP (hit dice: Fighter/Ranger d10, Rogue/Cleric/Bard d8, Wizard d6 via `CLASS_HIT_DICE`)
- Chosen ability score +2 (AC unchanged; scores not capped at 20)
- Route also generates flavor text (`generateLevelUpNarrative`, usually fallback per bug B-03), writes a `[Level Up] …` system log row, and adds a DM history turn

Frontend then runs `setCharacter`, `setCanLevelUp(false)`, shows a system message, and updates campaign slot level (`game-console.component.ts:187-194`). Note: one level per call — a character with enough XP for two levels must call `/api/levelup` twice.
